title: Crypto Verification Sequence (11-Step)
purpose: Detailed 11-step verifyAndRecordBasePayment flow showing every validation gate, RPC call, event parsing step, fee calculation, and DB recording with the sandbox bypass vulnerability
description: The core crypto payment verification pipeline: Crypto Payment Controller calls verifyAndRecordBasePayment with paymentInfo. The service performs dedup check (409 if hash exists), hash format validation (regex /^0x[A-Fa-f0-9]{64}$/), fetches creator's crypto_wallet from profiles, selects RPC network based on creator's payout preference (Base/Monad/MegaETH), calls eth_getTransactionReceipt via axios, validates receipt status=0x1, contract address match (receipt.to or log.address), parses events (topics[2] recipient check, data[0:32] amount with 1-cent tolerance), calculates platformFee=12.5% and creatorPayout, inserts transaction with status Cleared. The 0x0000 sandbox bypass skips all on-chain steps, creating verified transactions without blockchain proof.

preconditions: Fan is authenticated with valid JWT
Fan has initiated a crypto transaction through their wallet
Creator has crypto_wallet_address and crypto_wallet_payout_preference configured
Smart contract is deployed on the target network
postconditions: Transaction record created in transactions table with status 'Cleared'
blockchain_tx_hash recorded and unique constraint prevents replay
platform_fee and creator_payout calculated and stored
Subscription updated or content unlocked based on transactionType

nodes.label: Controller receives POST /verify
nodes.description: Crypto Payment Controller extracts txHash, creatorId, amountInCents, transactionType from request body

nodes.label: Call verifyAndRecordBasePayment
nodes.description: Controller delegates to cryptoPayment.service.ts verifyAndRecordBasePayment with paymentInfo object

nodes.label: Dedup Check: txHash exists?
nodes.description: Query transactions table for existing blockchain_tx_hash

nodes.label: Return 409 Conflict
nodes.description: Hash already processed, return existing record with 409

nodes.label: Hash Format Validation
nodes.description: Regex /^0x([A-Fa-f0-9]{64})$/ — reject malformed hashes

nodes.label: Return 400 Invalid Format
nodes.description: Hash does not match expected format

nodes.label: Fetch Creator Wallet
nodes.description: Query profiles table for creator's crypto_wallet_address and payout_preference

nodes.label: Return 400 Wallet Required
nodes.description: Creator has not configured a crypto wallet address

nodes.label: Sandbox Bypass Check
nodes.description: Check if txHash starts with '0x0000' — development bypass prefix

nodes.label: Skip On-Chain Verification
nodes.description: DEV ONLY: Skip all blockchain checks, proceed directly to fee calc and DB insert

nodes.label: Network Selection
nodes.description: Select RPC URL, USDC address, and chain ID based on creator's payoutPreference (base/monad/megaeth)

nodes.label: eth_getTransactionReceipt
nodes.description: Send axios POST to RPC endpoint with JSON-RPC payload for eth_getTransactionReceipt

nodes.label: Receipt Null Check
nodes.description: Check if RPC returned null receipt (transaction still pending)

nodes.label: Return 404 Pending
nodes.description: Transaction not yet mined, return pending status

nodes.label: Receipt Status Check
nodes.description: Verify receipt.status === '0x1' (success)

nodes.label: Return 400 Tx Failed
nodes.description: Transaction failed on-chain (status !== 0x1)

nodes.label: Contract Address Match
nodes.description: Check receipt.to === contractAddress OR any log.address === contractAddress

nodes.label: Return 400 Wrong Contract
nodes.description: Transaction interacted with a different contract

nodes.label: Parse Event Topics and Data
nodes.description: Extract topics[2] last 20 bytes as recipient address; parse data[0:32] as uint256 amount

nodes.label: Recipient Verification
nodes.description: Check topics[2] extracted address matches creator's configured wallet address

nodes.label: Return 400 Recipient Mismatch
nodes.description: Transaction recipient does not match creator's wallet

nodes.label: Amount Verification
nodes.description: Compare on-chain amount/10000 with expected amountInCents (±1 cent tolerance)

nodes.label: Return 400 Amount Mismatch
nodes.description: On-chain amount does not match expected payment amount

nodes.label: Calculate Platform Fee & Creator Payout
nodes.description: platformFee = Math.round(amount * 12.5 / 100); creatorPayout = amount - platformFee

nodes.label: INSERT Transaction Record
nodes.description: Create transaction with status='Cleared', payment_method='crypto', payment_currency='USDC', chain_id, blockchain_tx_hash

nodes.label: Return Success with Transaction
nodes.description: Return { transactionId, status: 'Cleared', txHash, amount, platformFee, creatorPayout }

nodes.label: Retry RPC Call
nodes.description: Retry eth_getTransactionReceipt with exponential backoff (500ms, 1000ms, 2000ms) up to 3 attempts

nodes.label: Return 503 Service Offline
nodes.description: All 3 RPC retry attempts exhausted

validationRules.rule: Creator crypto_wallet_address must not be null or empty
On-chain amount tolerance of 1 cent (amount/10000 vs expectedAmount)
EVENT_TOPICS are placeholder values — real keccak256 hashes not computed

businessRules.rule: Sandbox bypass (0x0000 prefix) intended for development only — must be gated behind NODE_ENV check
Payment types: Subscription, Tip, PPV Post, PPV Message

securityConsiderations: CRITICAL: Sandbox bypass allows any authenticated user to create verified transactions with fake 0x0000-prefixed hashes, bypassing all on-chain verification
EVENT_TOPICS are placeholder values (not real keccak256 hashes) — log parsing uses to-address match instead of topic0 filtering, which is weaker
Hardcoded fallback contract addresses would verify against non-existent contracts if env var is not set
No RPC API keys — public RPC endpoints are rate-limited and shared
No rate limiting on /verify endpoint — potential for RPC spam and abuse
Frontend uses raw fetch() for crypto endpoints, bypassing apiClient auth interceptors
performanceConsiderations: Blockchain RPC call adds 2-10 seconds latency per verification
No caching — each verification hits the blockchain and database
RPC retries with exponential backoff extend latency to ~3.5 seconds worst case
DB insert is append-only and lightweight

annotations.text: Sandbox bypass: Any txHash starting with 0x0000 skips all on-chain verification (steps 5-9). In production, any authenticated user can create fake verified transactions.
Event topic hashes (EVENT_TOPICS) are placeholder strings, not real keccak256 hashes — actual verification relies on to-address matching
Contract addresses are hardcoded placeholders — must be set via CONTRACT_ADDRESS env var for production
Three networks supported: Base (8453), Monad (10143), MegaETH (9999) based on creator's payoutPreference
